repository: This repository, named example-owner/example-repo in every fixture; only public objects were read.

version.json.description: `gh --version`; the health check reads the version with a regular expression.

auth-status.json.description: `gh auth status`; the health check reads the exit code and the New Project badge the "Logged in" line.

pr-view-preview.json.description: Pull request link preview (open pull request).

pr-view-observation.json.description: Core facts plus conversation comments (merged pull request).

pr-view-full.json.description: Full pull request details (merged pull request; it has no labels).

pr-view-body.json.description: The pull request description, for adversarial review (merged pull request).

pr-view-head-sha.json.description: The head commit, to anchor a review comment (open pull request).

api-pr-reviews.json.description: REST reviews, every page (merged pull request).

api-pr-review-comments.json.description: REST inline review comments, first page, newest update first (merged pull request).

graphql-review-threads.json.description: Review threads and the database ids of their comments (merged pull request).

graphql-thread-comments.json.description: The next page of one review thread's comments, after the end cursor of the first recorded thread (an empty page: no thread on the pull request has more than 100 comments).

graphql-open-prs.json.description: Open pull requests, for local branch matching.

graphql-review-requests.json.description: Review-request search, without the review-requested:@me qualifier (see deviation).

issue-list.json.description: Open issues for the Kanban board, without bodies (no assignee filter).

api-issue.json.description: REST issue, for an exact-number issue search.

api-repo-labels.json.description: REST repository labels, every page, for event-automation sources.

api-issue-events.json.description: REST issue events, one page with response headers, for event automations (see issueEventsPage in meta.json).

scrubbing: Allowlist by call shape and key path (scripts/record-upstream/gh-policies.mjs, treatments in gh-scrub.mjs): unlisted keys and headers are dropped (counted in droppedKeys); free text is "<text>"; logins are user-N, bot-N[bot] or app/bot-N; ids, commits, branches and cursors are fixed fakes; timestamps are fakes from 2026-01-01 in their real order; URLs keep github.com path words and pull request and issue numbers, every other number is a fake id and other hosts are example.invalid; auth status keeps only the active account, with a fake login, token and scopes.
